claims.text: This loan costs about $3,008 in finance charges over 60 months ($2,508 interest plus $500 in prepaid finance charges).
Your monthly leftover goes from $1,300 to $925 after the payment.
Your savings would go from $6,000 to $2,000 after the down payment — about 0.6 months of essential costs.
Your monthly payment is $375.14 for 60 months.
Over the full term your payments add up to $22,508.29.
The finance charge is $3,008.29: $2,508.29 of interest plus $500.00 of prepaid finance charges.
Counting the down payment, the total paid through this deal is $26,508.29.
The APR these terms work out to is 5.796%.
Before this loan, about $1,300 is left each month (before discretionary spending).
With this loan, about $925 would be left each month.
The payment is about 8.9% of your take-home pay.
After the down payment your savings would be $2,000.00.
Your savings cover about 2.1 months of essential costs today and about 0.6 months with this loan.
After this purchase your savings would cover less than one month of essential costs.
